B's close leaves the next step as a choice between two options and gives no date, though B is good on how the shift leads might see attendance tracking as surveillance. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers put agreeing on the problem ahead of any demo, have the shift leads speak first, give Kevin and Ola their own questions, and invent no figures. B's close also names an owner for each data pull and sets a dated follow-up meeting, while A's next step has no deadline. B's agenda has one small flaw: segments 2 and 3 overlap between 15 and 20 minutes.
